india_trends.title: Listed developers’ pre-sales set to jump 22% to ₹1.82 lakh crore in FY27
india_trends.summary: India’s top listed developers are set to post 22.3% growth in combined pre-sales to ₹1.82 lakh crore in FY27 from ₹1.49 lakh crore, Anarock estimates. Oberoi Realty is expected to lead growth, while most developers benefit from strong housing demand and rising premium home sales.
